Bounded recovery update (read-only; no builds/renders): `.git/closeout/README.md` identifies `session-notes.tar.gz` as historical notes used for missing-source recovery and explicitly says the closeout material is not qualification evidence.

The archive SHA-256 is `766094ee7b3f6de8043e5e4aea103c7b917c77d73d4b768740c6e52d94398bcf`. I listed it and streamed all 63 UTF-8 regular members (513,125 uncompressed bytes) in memory, without extracting files. Its notes/operator scripts describe September recovery/qualification. Searches for the original tape filenames, pre-rebuild/reference tapes, `rebuild-baseline`, original July commit IDs, July and `2026-07` recovered no original render configuration, invocation, tape/hash, comparator or missing baseline README. The GCC 14.2/CMake/Slang environment at `session-notes/WORK_LOG.md:11` belongs to work dated 2026-09-07 at line 3; it cannot establish July compiler/flags provenance. The archive's later byte-identity observations concern distinct September diagnostics.

I also inspected the trees of all 11 local `refs/archive/` tips and their 5,627 reachable Git object records for `renders/`, historical `SESSION_*`/`WORK_LOG.md`, `rebuild-baseline`, and forensic/tape preservation paths; none recovered the original evidence.

Coverage boundary: this excludes these named local recovery notes and targeted reachable archive paths as a recovered source for the July tape gate. It is not an exhaustive content audit of every historical Git blob, unreferenced Git object, remote/deleted archive, or external session store. Authentic tape/config/hash recovery remains open; no new reconstruction was generated. #44 continues independently.

Every result is `NEW_RECONSTRUCTION`. No render has run and no original tape identity, current-physics equivalence, science or release qualification is claimed. Full source export, explicit 115-byte GLFW build-scaffold overlay, build context, actual renderer ELFs, successful config/starfield joins, live loaded-library observations, raw owners, all six reconstructed images and exact comparator are preserved in [9fde062](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/9fde062e2d95f1fd679d57c2762d11859c9f1358), tag `evidence/issue-100-alcubierre-png-reconstruction-pair`.
